headline: Royalty income grows despite a one-time impairment
summary_short: Royalty Pharma's Q1 2026 revenue rose 11.0% y/y to $630.6M, with net income up 23.1% y/y to $294.7M ($0.67 diluted EPS), as Portfolio Receipts grew 10.3% y/y to $925.4M despite a $69.4M non-cash impairment on Tazverik.
summary_long: Revenue rose 11.0% y/y (1.4% q/q) to $630.6M, led by Evrysdi, Tremfya, Voranigo and the newly acquired Imdelltra royalty. Provision activity swung to $197.5M of income (vs $127.1M prior year) on higher consensus sales forecasts for Evrysdi, Tysabri and Xtandi. G&A rose 44.1% on post-Internalization share-based compensation; the company also booked a $69.4M non-cash Tazverik impairment after its market withdrawal. Net income attributable to Royalty Pharma rose 23.1% to $294.7M ($0.67 diluted EPS). The company paid a $0.235/share dividend, repurchased $50.1M of shares, and ended the quarter with $586.4M cash against $9.34B total debt. No explicit 2026 guidance was reiterated in this 10-Q.
